usedFor: A “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign can add that person to a Balsio thread.

bestTemplate.name: “New Contact” in ActiveCampaign, then “Add Users to Thread” in Balsio
bestTemplate.why: It adds the contact to the right thread by email, so the conversation exists already.

watchOut: “Add Users to Thread” works from an email address, so each new contact must arrive with one.
